chat.title: AIRA assistant
chat.subtitle: Ask AIRA to check data, create drafts, and submit approvals. Conversations are saved in Entaris.
chat.historyDescription: Search, open, or manage your AIRA sessions.

empty.title: What can AIRA help with?
empty.description: Write your request in everyday language or attach a photo of a receipt. Your conversations are saved in Entaris and important actions wait for approval.

examples.cashBook: Create a cash book draft from a receipt photo
examples.approvals: What is waiting for my approval?

engineBanner.notConfigured: The AIRA engine is not configured on the server.
engineBanner.keyRejected: The AIRA engine key was rejected.
engineBanner.keepMessages: Your messages are still saved and can be retried later.

composer.attachImageOrPdf: Attach an image or PDF (max. 10 MB)
composer.hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line · Esc to stop the answer

message.failed: The answer could not be generated.
message.stopped: Stopped. Text already received is kept.

sessionList.noSessions: No conversations yet. Start with “New session”.
sessionList.deleteDescription: “{{title}}” and all its messages and attachments will be permanently deleted and cannot be restored.

copy.failed: Could not copy. Copy it manually from the field next to it.

engine.title: AIRA engine (chat panel)
engine.description: The engine address and key are set through server environment variables (AIRA_ENGINE_URL, AIRA_ENGINE_KEY).

calls.title: Call history
calls.description: Every tool call from the AIRA engine: who, through which channel, the decision, and a link to the approval. Arguments are not stored.
calls.emptyDescription: Calls from the AIRA engine will appear here.

status.disabled: AIRA (MCP) disabled. All calls are rejected.
status.title: AIRA (MCP) status
status.description: Entaris serves all tools to the AI engine (AIRA engine) through a single MCP endpoint. Access rights follow the user being served.
status.killSwitchDescription: When turned off, every call to /mcp is rejected immediately with a 503 error. No tools run.
status.jwtSecretNotice: Token signing secrets are encrypted with a key derived from JWT_SECRET. Set a separate MCP_SECRET_KEY so that rotating JWT_SECRET does not make token secrets unreadable.
status.confirmOffDescription: All calls from the AIRA engine are rejected (503) until you turn it back on. Requests already awaiting approval are not affected.

endpoint.title: MCP endpoint
endpoint.description: One endpoint for all tools (Streamable HTTP, stateless). Reach it over a private network; do not expose it to the public internet.
endpoint.baseUrlHint: The address MCP clients use to reach Entaris (for example a private network address). Only changes the examples below.

tokens.revealDescription: Save it now in the AIRA engine's secret manager. This value is shown only once and cannot be viewed again.
tokens.secretWarning: The token and signing secret are equivalent to access keys. Do not share them over chat; revoke or rotate them if leaked.
tokens.savedConfirm: I have saved the values above
tokens.createDescription: One token per AIRA engine profile (for example aira-dev). The token and signing secret are shown once after creation.
tokens.defaultActorHint: Used when a call has no actor assertion (CLI / testing). Empty = assertion required. Only users granted AIRA access.
tokens.rotateFailed: Could not rotate the signing secret.
tokens.revoked: Token revoked. Calls with this token are rejected.
tokens.title: MCP tokens
tokens.description: One token per AIRA engine profile. The user identity is sent with each message through a signed actor assertion (HMAC with the token's signing secret).
tokens.emptyDescription: Create a token to connect an AIRA engine profile to Entaris.
tokens.rotateDescription: The old secret stops working immediately; actor assertions signed with the old secret are rejected until the AIRA engine uses the new secret.
tokens.revokeDescription: The token can no longer be used and revocation cannot be undone. Create a new token if the AIRA engine still needs to connect.
